name: xaf-modeleditor
description: Integrates DevExpress XAF Model Editor with VS Code. Right-click or double-click Model.xafml to build and launch the correct Model Editor version.

commands.title: XAF Model Editor: Reset 'Don't show again' dialog
XAF Model Editor: Set up Wine (Linux/macOS)

xafModelEditor.modelEditorPath.description: Optional: Override the path to the DevExpress Model Editor executable. On Linux/macOS this is required — point it at the Windows Model Editor .exe (it is launched via Wine). Example (Windows): D:/DevExpress/Tools/ModelEditor/DevExpress.ExpressApp.ModelEditor.v24.2.exe — Example (Linux): /home/me/source/Model Editor/DevExpress.ExpressApp.ModelEditor.x64.v25.2.exe

xafModelEditor.wineCommand.description: Non-Windows only: the Wine command used to run the Windows Model Editor .exe (e.g. 'wine' or 'wine64').

xafModelEditor.winePrefix.description: Non-Windows only: WINEPREFIX for the Model Editor. Must contain the Windows .NET 9 Desktop + ASP.NET Core runtimes. Defaults to ~/.wine-modeleditor when empty.
